requirement_vague: Verify an admin cannot change a user's email to an email already used by another user. Admin credentials: (admin@example.com / password123)
requirement_precise: Register two distinct users via the public signup operation, each with a different email and password. Authenticate as the superuser (admin@example.com / password123) to obtain an access token. Using the superuser access token, attempt to update the first registered user's email (update by id) so that it becomes the second user's email. Verify the response status is 409. Verify the response body contains a "detail" field equal to "User with this email already exists".

implementation.location: POST /api/v1/users/signup, POST /api/v1/login/access-token, PATCH /api/v1/users/{user_id} in update_user_by_id, plus startup init_superuser
